backfill_note: The post was published 2026-06-30 from a firsthand run on 2026-06-29. The original throwaway harness (exp.mjs) was not retained in the workspace — only the recorded firsthand-benchmark.md. This exp.mjs is a faithful reconstruction of that experiment, and it was RE-RUN on a freshly downloaded official Node v26.4.0 (the same build) while packaging; probe-result.json here is that fresh, genuine output, and every value matches the 2026-06-29 record. Because the checks are deterministic language behaviors on a pinned build, this is fully reproducible rather than a transcribed claim.

environment.runner: node (portable v26.4.0 build), no network, no deps
environment.tz: Asia/Seoul (system); the harness TZ export did not propagate to the Windows node.exe child, so probe-result.json reports tz '(unset)' — the two string-parsing rows still resolved against the KST system clock. On POSIX, run.sh's `export TZ=Asia/Seoul` propagates normally.
environment.note: This verifies language/runtime BEHAVIOR (Temporal global presence, immutability, DST arithmetic, overflow policy, parsing, removals), not timing. CPU/GPU/RAM do not affect the result and are intentionally omitted.

subject.name: nodejs
subject.note: npm_bundled is read from the dist index, not exercised by the harness.

baseline.name: legacy Date
baseline.note: The comparison is legacy `Date` (0-indexed months, in-place mutation, DST-blind ms math, silent overflow, ambiguous string parsing) vs the new `Temporal` global on the SAME runtime. No third library is executed.

not_measured.lts_timeline: LTS entry (2026-10) and the Node 27+ annual-major cadence are cited from official/InfoQ sources, not something a harness can observe.
not_measured.cross_platform: Only run on Windows x64 here. Temporal/Date behavior is platform-independent by spec, but the harness was not executed on Linux/macOS in this run; run.sh supports all three.

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: none discarded — all evidence for this run is small and committed
raw_artifacts.note: The downloaded node binary (~120MB extracted) is NOT committed; run.sh re-fetches the pinned official build into ./.node (gitignored). The deterministic evidence — probe-result.json — is committed.
